The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jomar Chul]] flew a '''ship''' that he used to scout the [[Dromund system]] before he was chased out of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and shot down over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
